_comment: TEMPLATE. Copy to .claude/settings.local.json, which is gitignored. Machine-specific protections that must not be published. Merged with settings.json; deny rules from both apply. Deny is the safe half to keep local: an allow rule that references a path you do not have is harmless, while a deny rule naming your live database schemas or absolute paths is infrastructure detail and belongs here rather than in the tracked settings.json.
_note_on_bypass: These lists are advisory only. A compound command can slip past a pattern-matched deny rule, which is why the real database guard is the PreToolUse hook .claude/hooks/guard-db.ps1 (it exits 2). Do not treat an entry here as a substitute for the hook, and never use --dangerously-skip-permissions in this repo: it disables permissions entirely and only PreToolUse hooks survive it.

deny: Bash(*<name of a live schema you must never write to>*)
Bash(*<absolute path you want kept out of reach>*)
